From the owner
Our Vision: Significance. To be a light in the community. To make a difference, to make an impact to all we touch. To be a team of leaders, focusing on excellence in performance while building long lasting relationships. Our Mission: To Serve. Our Customers – Goal- An outstanding customer experience Building trust by establishing realistic up-front expectations. Responsible communication and active listening. A professional timely process hitting the mark every time. Our Employees – Goal – providing a workplace of joy and harmony that honors God. Treat each individual as a winner. Calling out the potential within each other, challenging one another in personal growth. Pursue harmony together, with compassion and kindness to all. Our Community – Goal – Partnering with local causes through our gifts and talents in a way that glorifies God. Give back value, physically or monetarily. Be known for the principles of trust, integrity and honesty. Be a light in the lives we touch. Our Purpose: To create beautiful spaces. Enhancing spaces with integrity and value. Provide a comfortable, enjoyable process. Create positive impact thru sharing our gifts and talents. Our Goal: Continuous incremental growth. Personally and professionally Authenticity – with accountability and vulnerability. Our Core Values: Integrity, 3 C’s- Creativity, Communication, Courteousness, Team Commitment, Leadership in Action, Effective Execution
